_comment: Zone for the local dev nameserver (tools/local-dns.mjs).
.test is reserved by RFC 6761 and never resolves on the public internet,
so nothing here can leak a real query or shadow a real site.
sainted-word.test -> the Vite dev server, so http://sainted-word.test:5174/
mirrors production, where / is rewritten to /landing.html.
Port 5354 rather than 53: binding 53 needs root, and macOS resolver
files take a per-client `port`, so an unprivileged server is fine — see
upstream: empty means auto-detect the machine's own resolvers (scutil,
then /etc/resolv.conf) at boot. Pin it here to override, e.g. ["1.1.1.1"].
